content.short: PoolTogether Subgraph indexes PoolTogether smart contract events.
content.description: PoolTogether Subgraph enables efficient access to PoolTogether data by indexing its smart contracts and turning on-chain activity into searchable information. It makes it possible for developers to query deposits by users, prize balances, token purchases, and related events. By providing a standardized GraphQL API endpoint, this subgraph streamlines the indexing and organization of on-chain protocol data, empowering apps to build richer dashboards and experiences around PoolTogether’s pools and prizes.
